extraction.document_summary: Singlife Multipay Critical Illness II is a multipayout critical illness insurance plan covering 135 critical illness conditions across early, intermediate and severe stages, with continued protection through multiple payouts (including recurrence). It pays: (1) 100% of sum assured for one eligible early/intermediate condition in one lump sum; (2) 100% of sum assured for severe stage conditions (one claim per CI Group), with a stated overall Critical Illness Benefit cap of 600% of sum assured; (3) recurrent payouts after the Critical Illness Benefit has ceased—150% of sum assured per eligible recurrent claim (up to 2 claims, 300% total). A first severe-stage diagnosis also triggers premium waiver. Additional “special benefits” can add 20% of sum assured per eligible item/condition with a cap of S$25,000 (or equivalent currency) per life, and an Advance Care Option can add another 75% of sum assured (and terminates the Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit). Coverage term is selectable from 10 years up to age 99 (in one-year intervals) and can be taken in SGD, USD, GBP, EUR, AUD or HKD. The brochure also states there is no savings/investment feature, hence no cash value if the policy ends.
quality_notes: Brochure contains clear benefit mechanics, payout percentages, caps, waiting periods, and recurrence claim limits.
Detailed lists of covered conditions are referenced but not provided; the brochure points to the Product Summary for full lists.
Underwriting details, precise premium payment term, and free-look/grace period are not stated in this extract.
Some benefit sub-clauses are embedded as “Important Notes” and give necessary constraints (e.g., ICU in Singapore admission, claim counts, benefit cessation triggers).

policies.quick_summary: Multipay critical illness plan with early/intermediate and severe-stage lump-sum payouts (100% of sum assured per stage/CI Group, subject to overall Critical Illness Benefit cap of 600%), plus a separate recurrent illness component paying 150% per eligible recurrent claim (up to two claims; 300% total). Premiums are waived upon the first severe stage diagnosis, and additional “special benefits” can pay extra 20% of sum assured (capped at S$25,000 per life). An Advance Care Option can add an extra 75% of sum assured and terminates the recurrent component. Coverage term selectable from 10 years to age 99 and currency choices include SGD, USD, GBP, EUR, AUD, HKD.
coverage_scope: Critical Illness Benefit: Early, Intermediate and Severe Stage critical illnesses (135 conditions across stages, subject to covered condition list)
Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit: specified severe-stage conditions and recurrences after CI Benefit has ceased
Special Benefits (additional 20% of sum assured, subject to cap and eligibility per condition/item)
Premium waiver upon first severe stage critical illness diagnosis
policies.residency_requirements: ICU stay of 4 days or more (due to illness or accident) must be in one hospital admission in Singapore for the Intensive Care Unit benefit.
policies.eligibility_notes: All ages mentioned refer to age next birthday. Full eligibility rules and complete list of covered illnesses are stated in the Product Summary (not in this extract).
policies.coverage_term_description: Choice of coverage term from 10 years up to age 99 (in one-year intervals).
policy_termination_events: Critical Illness Benefit ceases once 600% of the sum assured is fully paid out
Critical Illness Benefit ceases when the Advance Care Option is successfully exercised under the Policy (earlier cessation stated for Recurrent benefit termination and notes)
Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit ceases once 300% of the sum assured is fully paid out, or when Advance Care Option is successfully exercised, whichever is earlier
Some benefit components (e.g., Special Benefit, Intensive Care Unit benefit) state cessation triggers tied to claim date, policy anniversary age (e.g., 85) and/or policy expiry (see important notes)
important_caveats: The brochure states the product has no savings/investment feature; there is no cash value if the policy ends or is terminated prematurely.
Complete list of covered critical illnesses is referenced but not provided in this extract; the Product Summary is required for details.
Recurrence payouts apply only after the Critical Illness Benefit has ceased and subject to waiting/survival period rules (waiting periods are partially stated).
Advance Care Option adds an extra 75% of sum assured but terminates the Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit once exercised.

source_evidence.quote: Be it early, intermediate or severe stage, you’re covered across 135 conditions with continued protection after diagnosis, backed by multiple payouts.
Get an additional 20% of your sum assured (up to S$25,000) per life
This policy is underwritten by Singapore Life Ltd.
As this product has no savings or investment feature, there is no cash value if the policy ends or if the policy is terminated prematurely.

review_notes: Condition lists (135 conditions; 75 early/intermediate; 60 severe; 34 special conditions; and the 6 specified severe conditions for Advance Care Option) are referenced but not enumerated in this extract; details are stated to be in the Product Summary.

Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit payout mechanics are stated; the extract includes a table with 2-year waiting period between recurrent claims and important notes specifying the 150% per claim up to 2 claims (300% total).
